title: Environment Protection Act 2001 (قانون حماية البيئة لسنة 2001)
citation: Act No. 18 of 2001, dated 23/6/2001, Ninth Revised Edition of the Laws of Sudan
evidence: The page prints "قانون حماية البيئة لسنة2001" with the date "(23/6/2001)" and footnote (1) "قانون رقم 18 لسنة 2001". No commencement clause is printed, so the date of issue is used. Opened https://www.moj.gov.sd/sudanlaws/epub/EPUB/xhtml/szoc49.html on 2026-11-09 (HTTP 200, sha256 d20025089fd759345e45abf469aaa2cf3e024c8d61ddd6300f88f3d769e67d7b).
notes: Framework environment law: art. 20 lists prohibited acts (air, water, food and soil pollution, noise, felling trees, genetically modified organisms without controls); art. 21 sets prison up to three years or a fine and permits closing the activity; art. 2 repeals the Higher Council for Environment and Natural Resources Act 1991; art. 24 has the Ministry set pollution-control standards. The brief gave "Act No. 18 of 2001", confirmed by footnote (1). No emissions-reporting or climate disclosure duty. Stored: Arabic (ar), one consolidated record dated 2015-03-30, the state of the Ninth Revised Edition of the Laws of Sudan, whose introduction (xhtml/sibyrw.html) says it lists all Sudanese laws in force from 1903 to 30 March 2015. The edition prints the law's date of issue in brackets under the title but no commencement clause, so in_force here is the date of issue, as the Syria entry does; the record is dated with the edition's cut-off, so amendments after 2015-03-30 are not in it. The footnotes of the page name the amending laws. Text is the whole page of the e-book as served, tags stripped. No government English text: https://www.moj.gov.sd/en (HTTP 200, 613 bytes) carries no law texts, the Ministry's laws reader is Arabic only (package.opf dc:language ar), and the WIPO Lex Sudan profile (https://www.wipo.int/wipolex/en/members/profile/SD) lists no law of this subject, so no translation row.

title: Central Bank of Sudan Policies for 2024 (سياسات بنك السودان المركزي للعام 2024م)
citation: Circular no. ب س/م م/2023 of the Governor of the Central Bank of Sudan, dated 31 December 2023 (18 Jumada al-Akhirah 1445 AH), forwarding the 2024 policies
evidence: Page 1 of the PDF, read from the page image and OCR: "أرجو أن نرفق لكم سياسات بنك السودان المركزي للعام 2024م، وذلك للعمل بموجبها اعتباراً من الأول من يناير 2024م" (to be applied from 1 January 2024). Opened https://cbos.gov.sd/sites/default/files/CentralBankSudanPolicies2024.pdf on 2026-11-09 (HTTP 200, 6972571 bytes, application/pdf, sha256 2c1744d1efaa73de31d6a158d1794f70b763fcc37dec820a8e2941f46e05ca8d).
notes: Confirmed F6: the circular is addressed to bank, exchange-house, money-transfer, microfinance and leasing company managers. Its fourth axis, "المحور الرابع: التمويل الأخضر" (green finance), says the policies aim to create a favourable environment for sustainable green finance and to respond to climate-change risks, and lists financing solar energy for industry and households, including sustainability and green finance principles in the activities of banks and financial institutions, encouraging environment-friendly products, and applying governance and climate-risk management to green finance products. It states policy aims, not a disclosure or reporting duty. The PDF is image-only (pdftotext returns nothing); the page content was read by OCR (tesseract ara) for this check only. Link only: the bank claims the copyright and allows personal non-commercial printing only (see SD-CBOS-ADOPTED); no English translation was looked for beyond the bank site, which lists the Arabic PDF only.
status_note: Row SD-CBOS-ADOPTED is permission requested; no text stored.
